candidates.title: FlashQuant: Sparse-Dense Fusion for Memory-Efficient Outlier-Aware LLM Inference
candidates.reason: FlashQuant fuses low-bit dense GEMM and high-precision sparse outlier computation to eliminate redundant memory traffic during memory-bound decoding, directly extending quantized inference-kernel lineages.

candidates.title: A Thread-Register Decoupled GPU Execution Model for Efficient Tensor Computation
candidates.reason: FIBER redesigns GPU tensor execution to decouple scheduling and operand state for mixed GEMM/non-GEMM AI workloads, offering a hardware execution model relevant to LLM inference kernel efficiency.

candidates.title: FlashDrive: Flash Vision-Language-Action Inference for Autonomous Driving
candidates.reason: FlashDrive is an end-to-end algorithm-system co-design that attacks visual encoding, prefill reuse, reasoning-token generation and denoising bottlenecks together, extending heterogeneous real-time inference lineages.

candidates.title: SSDi8: Accurate and Efficient 8-bit Quantization for State Space Duality
candidates.reason: SSDi8 develops a persistent INT8 execution path tailored to Mamba-2/SSD rather than Transformer-only assumptions, broadening low-precision inference coverage to state-space architectures.

candidates.title: PRQuant: Permutation Residual Quantization for Low-Overhead Inference
candidates.reason: PRQuant combines AWQ-style scaling, channel permutation and static weight-side residual compensation to reduce low-bit inference overhead, directly updating weight-quantization deployment lineages.
